description: Port the contributions pipeline to Python (docs/UNIFIED-PROJECT-PLAN.md §7 port band): the contribution review queue, AI-review promotion into the TSV corpus, API-key auth + rate-limiting. Pure-TS logic today; reimplement on the FastAPI service behind the parity gate. Runs in parallel with the other 6x-port tasklists.

userStories.title: Port the contribution queue + review + promotion
userStories.description: Reimplement contribution-service (JSON-per-record store under data/runtime/contributions), the review/open flow, and ai-review promotion of accepted drafts into the lexicon TSVs.
acceptanceCriteria: The contributions and ai-review routes are served by auto-registered Python routers and pass the parity tests.
The runtime store reads/writes data/runtime/contributions (matching current behavior); promotion writes back to the lexicon TSVs.
The Express handlers for these routes are removed or return 501; the coverage tracker is updated.

userStories.title: Port API-key auth + rate-limiting
userStories.description: Reimplement the API-key authentication and rate-limiting that guards the contribution endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth + rate-limit behavior matches the current server (same accept/reject/429 semantics) and is covered by tests.
Parity tests for the guarded endpoints pass.
